messages:
Emily (AE): Heads up — ACME Health legal surfaced a POC blocker. They want a written uptime commitment (>=99.9%), BYO-KMS key wrap, and assurance that all inference traffic/data stays in their VPC for the pilot. Also asking for 3-week dedicated POC pricing at ~50 req/s with a trial discount. Need SSO + SCIM. Can SRE/security/eng advise?
Raj (SRE): I can take the perf/throughput ask. 50 req/s with 8k tokens avg is doable on a 2-GPU Dedicated pool with autoscale. Need to confirm burst profile and KV cache hit rate.
Marta (Security): BYO-KMS is fine for Private deploy; for Hosted we need to confirm key wrapping options. Also need the completed Security Questionnaire they attached — they've asked for SOC2 and TLS cipher list. Can we get their SQ PDF?
Emily (AE): Attached — their CISO sent SQ_v3.pdf. They want a timeline: legal + sec approval in 48h or they pull pilot start.
Sam (Eng): Quick notes: 1) For VPC-only pilot we can deploy Redwood Private in their VPC (customer-managed control plane) — supports BYO-KMS and egress controls. 2) For a hosted-but-isolated option we can do Dedicated with VPC peering + egress rules, but BYO-KMS isn't available in hosted.
Olivia (CS): I'll coordinate a CISO bridge. Proposed times: today 3pm PT or tomorrow 10am PT. Emily — which do they prefer?
Emily (AE): They're available today 3pm. Please add Raj and Marta.
Raj (SRE): FYI on the risk items from ops: if we route to their VPC we need these firewall ports open: ``TCP 443 outbound to r-inference-us.example.com``, and inbound only from their NAT. Also we need 2 IPs reserved for the Dedicated frontends.
Marta (Security): From security checklist: we need to confirm key lifecycle (rotate/rotate window), HSM attestation docs if BYO-HSM, and an answer on data-at-rest encryption for log storage. I'll draft responses.
Emily (AE): On pricing: they've asked for trial discount and a statement of work. Can finance provide a 3-week POC quote (Dedicated capacity + eng support hours)?@Finance?
Sam (Eng): Suggestion: offer a canary plan — private POC in their VPC for first week, then fallback to Dedicated for weeks 2–3 if they want less ops overhead. That reduces our risk while meeting BYO-KMS.
Olivia (CS): Noted. I'll propose that to the CISO.
DeployBot: Request created: REQ-POC-8719 (owner: Emily). Please attach the signed SOW to REQ-POC-8719 when ready.
Marta (Security): I'll upload answers to the SQ and KMS guidance before the bridge. If CISO wants HSM attestation, we may need an exec note — we don't ship customer-side HSM attestation docs without legal sign-off.
Raj (SRE): For capacity sizing, give me the exact token distribution and expected concurrency spikes. If they send a sample prompt trace (sanitized) I can simulate 95th percentile latency.
Emily (AE): I'll get the prompt trace and the signed SQ draft from the customer now. Also asking for a written uptime commitment sample — is 99.9% acceptable for a 3-week pilot?
Sam (Eng): 99.9% SLO is reasonable for Dedicated with our standard monitoring/auto-replace. For Private deployments we can support it but need SLA language review by Legal.
Marta (Security): If legal needs to escalate, loop in @VP Security. We should prepare the minimal exceptions register — I'll start a short risk register doc.
Olivia (CS): Action items: Emily to share prompt trace + SQ; Sam/Raj to confirm capacity and ports; Marta to draft SQ answers and risk register; Finance to produce a 3-week POC quote. Bridge at 3pm PT today.
Emily (AE): Thanks team — will ping once I have the docs. :thumbsup:
